architecture.summary: Only the Members page embedded CSS changes. Existing revoke forms receive a muted red background, border, and text with a brighter hover state. Resend, labels, focus outline, form destinations, submitted fields, authority checks, and handlers keep their behavior. The selector matches the existing root and prefixed invitations/revoke routes. No callable signature, public contract, dependency, component responsibility, resource lifetime, trust boundary, or deployment topology changes. The web ownership entry, hosted authentication components, member-read runtime view, and adjacent context/container/deployment views remain accurate. No registry diagram or prose edit is needed; no L4 comparison is needed.
